postconditions.description: The permutation p has n elements.
The permutation q has n - 2 elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
postconditions.description: Each element of p is an integer between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= qi <= n - 2 for qi in q)
postconditions.description: Each element of q is an integer between 1 and n - 2.
The permutation p contains each integer from 1 to n exactly once.
The permutation q contains each integer from 1 to n - 2 exactly once.
The permutation p is a valid enumeration of the n-sided cake vertices.
The permutation q is a valid order of cutting the pieces of the cake.
